content: ऐन्द्र {%a.%} (-न्द्री|{%f.%}) [इन्द्र-अण्] Belonging or sacred to Indra; ऋद्धं हि राज्यं पदमैन्द्रमाहुः <ls>R. 2. 50</ls>: 6. 27. .{@-न्द्रः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Arjuna and of Vāli (who are regarded as sons of इन्द्र). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a Saṃvatsara. .²3 The part of a sacrifice offered to Indra. .{@-न्द्री@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a {%Ṛik%} addressed to Indra; इत्यादिका काचिदैन्द्री समाम्नाता <ls>J. N. V.</ls> .²2 The east, eastern direction (presided over by Indra); अयमैन्द्रीमुखं पश्य रक्तश्चुम्बति चन्द्रमाः <ls>Chandr. 5. 58</ls>; <ls>Ki. 9. 18</ls>. .²3 The eighteenth lunar mansion. .²4 The eighth day in the second half of the months of मार्गशीर्ष and पौष. .²5 Indraʼs energy (personified as his wife Śachī). .²6 Misfortune, misery. .²7 A kind of cucumber. .²8 An epithet of Durgā. .²9 Small cardamom; यष्टपाह्वमैन्द्रीनलिनानि दूर्वा <ls>Charaka.</ls> .{@-न्द्रम्@} .²1 The eighteenth lunar mansion (ज्येष्ठा). .²2 Wild ginger.
